GOMAXPROCS=2; pool cap=2; native concurrency cap=2; Wasm concurrency follows two benchmark workers.
No compilation cache. Authorization reuses loaded state. Compiled analysis has one warm query.
Each sample starts a fresh benchmark process. Native static linking is outside timed Runtime construction.
Order alternates native/Wasm per sample. RSS measures the parent process after closed solver sessions.
Native source: e65f80b3fc2644c42a6b65ab7ee36dd4c41180ed120cc28a4e078442cc168d68
Wasm source: f38e65e3dc21bf932e7af73c0e39b307dce4991532d447ef030e30bafded8507
Source and backend hashes remained unchanged throughout the measurements.
